score_translation_batch: score a batch of translations using an ensemble of fairseq models and return hypothesis scores
compute_target_token_probs: compute normalized probabilities for target tokens given decoder output from a fairseq model
batch_softmax_for_large_sequences: batch softmax computation across large sequences to stay within memory limits using softmax_batch
gather_target_probs_from_decoder: gather target token probabilities from decoder output using index gathering on the probability tensor
extract_attention_alignment: extract attention weights and token alignment from the decoder output for scored translations
